office_does: The Director of Elections runs King County's elections, including voter registration, ballot counting and results.
race_blurb: Incumbent Julie Wise, director since 2015, is unopposed.

candidates.summary: Incumbent King County Director of Elections, first elected in 2015, with 26 years at the department after starting in its phone bank in 2000.
highlights: During her tenure the county went from 10 ballot drop boxes to more than 80 [S2]
Pushed for prepaid ballot postage, which the department says led to statewide prepaid postage in 2018 [S2]
Added four non-English languages and started the Voter Education Fund; cites a Bipartisan Observer Program [S1][S2]
